content.definition: Arrangement where seller bills customer but retains physical possession of goods at customer's request
content.key_question: Has control transferred to customer even though seller still has possession?
content.general_rule: Revenue NOT recognized until control transfers. Physical possession indicator of control, but not determinative.
asc_606_criteria_all_must_be_met: 1. Substantive reason for arrangement (customer requested, benefits customer)
2. Product identified separately as customer's (not available for sale to others)
3. Product ready for transfer (complete, no further action required)
4. Seller cannot use product or direct it to another customer
content.if_criteria_met: Recognize revenue (control transferred). Continue to hold goods as custodian.
content.if_criteria_not_met: Do NOT recognize revenue. Wait until customer takes possession.

example_meets_criteria.scenario: Customer lacks warehouse space, requests seller hold completed goods. Seller segregates inventory with customer's name, cannot sell to others. Goods complete and ready.
example_meets_criteria.entry: DR AR, CR Revenue. Inventory remains on seller's books (held as custodian). May separately track as 'Inventory held for others'.

example_fails_criteria.scenario: Seller offers to hold goods to help meet sales targets. Customer hasn't requested, goods not segregated, seller could redirect to others.
example_fails_criteria.analysis: Fails criteria. Do NOT recognize revenue until customer takes possession.
example_fails_criteria.treatment: Inventory remains seller's. No revenue recognized.

common_red_flags.end_of_period_timing: Many bill-and-hold sales at quarter/year-end (management pressure to meet targets)
common_red_flags.can_redirect: Seller retains ability to sell to others

custodial_services.if_separate_performance_obligation: If storage/custodial services distinct, may be separate performance obligation (allocate portion of transaction price)
custodial_services.typically_not_distinct: Usually custodial services not distinct (incidental to sale)

risks_and_rewards.seller_retains_risk: If seller still bears significant risk (damage, obsolescence), indicates control NOT transferred
risks_and_rewards.transfer_of_risk: Customer bears risk of loss/damage while in seller's possession (indicator control transferred)

cpa_exam_tips: Bill-and-hold: Control must transfer for revenue recognition (not just billing)
Four criteria (all must be met): Substantive reason, Identified as customer's, Ready for transfer, Cannot redirect
Red flags: End-of-period timing, seller-initiated, not segregated, can redirect to others
If criteria not met: No revenue (wait for customer possession)
Physical possession ≠ control (control can transfer without possession)

key_points: Bill-and-hold: Seller bills but retains possession at customer's request
Revenue recognized only if control transfers (meet all 4 criteria)
Criteria: Substantive reason, Identified separately, Ready for transfer, Cannot redirect
Red flags: End-of-period timing, seller-initiated, not segregated
